d:
Bihar men navanbar ke aakhiri saptah men subah ke samay kohre ka asar dikhne laga hai. mausam vibhag ke mutabik 25 se 30 navanbar tak pradesh men mausam shushk rahega aur barish ki sanbhavna nahin hai. janie patna, gaya samet sabhi jilon men tapman aur kohre ko lekar IMD ka taja purvanuman.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
